research.claim: Smart View is an Excel/Office add-in giving multidimensional pivot analysis and full Excel functionality to interactively analyze balances and define reports
Smart View uses a Microsoft Office interface designed for EPM, BI, and Fusion Financials products, connecting via shared connections configured to the environment
